topic: Momonosuke already refused to open Wano's borders after the war, and called it cowardice
title: Momonosuke Already Refused Oden's Final Wish
description: After Kaidou falls, Yamato asks Momonosuke to finally open Wano's borders like Oden always wanted. Momonosuke says no, and asks if that makes him a coward. That's canon, chapter 1041. From the full story: What If Oden Never Opened Wano's Borders?
comment: Was Momonosuke right to keep Wano closed, or is he betraying his father's dream? Pick one.

lines.text: Momonosuke already refused to open Wano's borders, and almost nobody talks about it.

shot.fallback: young ruler standing before a closed gate

lines.text: Chapter 1041. After the war. After Kaidou falls.

shot.fallback: young ruler standing in a quiet aftermath

lines.text: Yamato asks him to finish his father's dream and open the country.

shot.fallback: warrior making a request to a young ruler

lines.text: Momonosuke says no. He's scared it'll put his own people in danger.

shot.fallback: young ruler looking anxious and uncertain

lines.text: Then he asks Yamato one question straight to his face.

shot.fallback: young ruler speaking directly to an ally

lines.text: Does that make me a coward?

shot.fallback: young ruler's face, uncertain and searching

lines.text: That's not fan theory. That's Oda's own panel, chapter 1041.

shot.fallback: manga panel of a young ruler in doubt

lines.text: Oden spent his whole life feeling trapped by those same borders.

shot.fallback: young samurai staring past a border wall

lines.text: His own son just chose to keep them shut anyway.

shot.fallback: young ruler standing before closed gates

lines.text: Not out of cowardice. Out of love for people Oden never got to protect himself.

shot.fallback: young ruler protecting his people, resolute

lines.text: So maybe the real question isn't whether Momonosuke is a coward...

shot.fallback: young ruler lost in difficult thought

lines.text: It's whether Momonosuke already refused the one thing his father died wanting.

shot.fallback: young ruler standing alone before a closed gate
